purpose: Current original issue acceptance mapping input; all five remain open and no acceptance is asserted.

issues.title: gzip: add compressed DEFLATE output and streaming decode
issues.body:
Parent issue: #11

The repair added and verified gzip, gunzip and zcat stream handling, CRC checks, concatenated members and partial-error output. Compression currently emits stored DEFLATE blocks and the command rejects compression-level options, so the original issue is only partially complete.

Acceptance:
- Add pure-MoonBit LZ/Huffman compression with level selection.
- Confirm compressible fixtures shrink and remain interoperable with pinned gzip.
- Reduce decoder whole-input buffering while preserving concatenated members, CRC failures and partial output.
- Record memory and throughput observations separately from semantic compatibility.
- Update README, compatibility, ADR and release tests before publication.
issues.display_title: gzip: add compressed DEFLATE output and streaming decode

issues.title: sed: complete hold space, branching, multiline commands and matcher grammar
issues.body:
Parent issue: #12

The repair verified BRE/ERE substitution, captures, address/range selection and ordered scripts. Hold space, branching, multiline commands, append/insert operations and the remaining matcher grammar are still outside the supported profile.

Acceptance:
- Implement the remaining pure-MoonBit sed execution model and shared matcher features.
- Compare empty matches, backreferences, branching, multiline input and partial output with pinned GNU sed.
- Preserve invalid-script status, output and writeback boundaries.
- Keep in-place editing blocked until public metadata and truncate APIs are available.
- Update README, compatibility, ADR and Native/Wasm/MoonX regressions before publication.
issues.display_title: sed: complete hold space, branching, multiline commands and matcher grammar

issues.title: diff and patch: add directory, whitespace, fuzz, offset and reject-file workflows
issues.body:
Parent issue: #15

The repair verified normal, unified and context text output, labels, binary detection, exact hunks, reverse, stdout and dry-run behavior. Directory and whitespace modes, fuzzy and offset application, reject files, mixed partial success and remaining writeback metadata behavior are still outside the supported profile.

Acceptance:
- Implement the remaining pure-MoonBit diff and patch workflows.
- Compare multiple files and hunks, whitespace modes, offsets, fuzz, reject files, partial success and failure ordering with pinned GNU diffutils and patch.
- Preserve dry-run and stdout behavior and record file and mode effects where public APIs permit.
- Update README, compatibility, ADR and cross-backend release regressions before publication.
issues.display_title: diff and patch: add directory, whitespace, fuzz, offset and reject-file workflows

issues.title: common command options: finish the remaining algorithmic and path semantics
issues.body:
Parent issue: #18

The repair added and verified selected options across fold, hexdump and od, checksums, split and csplit, fmt, expr and related commands. The broader option inventory still contains unimplemented formatting, merge, complement, group, filter, path and metadata modes.

Acceptance:
- Split each remaining command-specific option family into independently testable contracts.
- Compare success, conflicts, invalid arguments, partial output and side effects with pinned upstream tools.
- Keep options requiring readlink, mode, identity or timestamp setters in explicit boundary state until released public APIs exist.
- Update each package README and help text, compatibility record, ADR and release manifest with the exact supported subset.
issues.display_title: common command options: finish the remaining algorithmic and path semantics

issues.title: large-input handling: complete streaming and resource-boundary work
issues.body:
Parent issue: #17

The repair removed seq's artificial record-count cap and verified 10,000,001 records with bounded output buffering. Other large-input and memory-boundary work remains for split and csplit, sort, tac and rev, diff, column and strings, and gzip.

Acceptance:
- Define per-command memory and failure-effect contracts before changing buffering.
- Add large byte-equivalence cases, interruption behavior and resource observations for the remaining commands.
- Preserve pure-MoonBit implementations and distinguish product limits from test timeouts.
- Record any API-dependent refusal in async-upstream-gaps and the applicable ADR.
issues.display_title: large-input handling: complete streaming and resource-boundary work
